actions.exact_result_status: Cologix announced acquisition of approximately 154 acres in Johnstown, Ohio for a planned eight-data-center AI-ready campus with potential 800 MW scalable capacity across 2.0 million square feet; first phase anticipated to begin in 2025.
actions.access_caveat: Company announcement establishes planned full-buildout scope; it is not a local permit or energization record.

actions.exact_result_status: Council minutes state an Orange Township JEDD amendment was for a Cologix data center project occupying roughly 28 acres near Green Meadows Drive and Home Road with a data center approximately 135,000 square feet in size; Orange Township was conducting a parallel hearing.
actions.access_caveat: Minutes document economic-development/JEDD process context, not a building permit or energization.

actions.exact_result_status: Ohio EPA Construction NOI list, report date 2026-08-10, includes permit 4GC10275*AG for Cologix COL5 at 6787 Green Meadows Drive, Lewis Center, Delaware County, with 25.78 acres of total land disturbance and issue date 2024-12-18.
actions.access_caveat: Stormwater NOI supports site-work/construction activity but is not a building permit or occupancy/energization record.

actions.exact_result_status: Ohio EPA Construction NOI list, report date 2026-08-10, includes permit 4GC10864*AG for Cologix 7&8 at Duncan Plains Road, Johnstown, Licking County, with 154.47 acres of total land disturbance and issue date 2025-10-07.
actions.access_caveat: Stormwater NOI supports site-work/construction activity but is not a building permit or occupancy/energization record.

actions.exact_result_status: Ohio EPA Copermittee list, report date 2026-08-10, includes multiple copermittees for Cologix 7&8 at Duncan Plains Road under permit 4GC10864*AG; listed issue dates range from 2025-12-30 through 2026-06-12.
actions.access_caveat: Copermittee records identify construction participants under the stormwater permit; they do not establish building completion or energization.

actions.exact_result_status: BZA minutes for an adjacent/nearby sign case describe land use to the north as the under-construction Cologix Data Center and state there was active construction on the larger future Cologix Data Center site north of 6853 Green Meadows Drive.
actions.access_caveat: The Cologix facts are contextual statements in minutes for another case; useful for status corroboration but not a Cologix permit approval.

actions.exact_result_status: Authority approved a 50% data-center tax exemption for 10 years for Cologix in Orange Township, Delaware County and Johnstown, Licking County, in exchange for 90 FTEs, $10 million annual new payroll, and retention of $5,185,126 annual payroll; vote was 3–0 yes, with two abstentions.
actions.access_caveat: State tax action is not local zoning or a building permit.

actions.exact_result_status: Ohio EPA copermittee list includes a Cologix 7&8 facility record in Licking County; the list does not give a local vote or occupancy result.
actions.access_caveat: List entry is an environmental administrative record; it is not sufficient to establish a building permit or energization.
